local: I1: this machine’s saved Gemini CLI sessions, counts only

verdicts.claim: On this machine's saved Gemini CLI sessions, acg import --harness gemini imports every session with a reply, each record failing P1, and refuses every session without one, writing nothing; so no imported real session passes P1.
verdicts.measured: 3 real sessions: 2 of the 2 with a reply imported, each failing P1; 1 of the 1 without one refused, nothing written; imported records passing P1: 0

verdicts.claim: Over organ 6's 500 synthetic sessions and the same 500 cut short at a random point, nothingToJudge is true for exactly the records with no model call, and for 40 of them, chosen in turn, acg import refuses exactly those and imports the rest.
verdicts.measured: 1000 synthetic sessions, whole and cut short: nothing to judge said for exactly those with no model call in 1000 (157 had none); acg import refused or imported as it should in 40 of 40

verdicts.claim: The same for a Claude Code transcript: one with no assistant request is refused by acg import, writing nothing, and one with a request is imported and fails P1.
verdicts.measured: a Claude Code transcript with no assistant request refused, nothing written: yes; one with a request imported: yes, failing P1: yes
